source: Equity adaptation ACCT-004/PLAN short-borrow sensitivity; the source video's futures do not require stock borrowing.
schema: Optional costs.borrow_scenario freezes name, NY coverage dates, symbols, completeness, assumed/synthetic mode, note and up to10000 full-state events. Events carry symbol, aware minute effective_at, strict available/recall booleans and finite annual_rate0..5. Duplicate symbol/instant, unsupported symbols, incomplete/outside coverage, numeric/naive/subminute times and malformed JSON reject. Constant Costs remain the initial state until that symbol first changes. This does not establish historical lending or exact broker fees/collateral.
clock: Events are assumed observable at effective_at. New short attempts use actual opening or synthetic-close time; unavailable/recalled state rejects. Availability loss alone does not close an existing loan. Recall latches per existing loan once any recall event occurs since entry; later clearance cannot erase it. Close at first observed regular minute opening at/after recall, before ordinary gap exits, with modeled market costs and reason borrow_recall. No phantom weekend/holiday execution. Longs are unaffected.
financing: Integrate annual_rate times elapsed calendar seconds/(365*86400), piecewise, times held quantity and prior known mark. Rate at interval start applies; an event at interval end cannot change the prior interval. Preserve last-close notional between observations, opening notional within a minute, split/distribution ordering and frozen monetary tolerances. Recalls do not stop interest before actual exit.
freeze: The entire validated scenario is nested in frozen Costs and applicable job/study/result identities. Validate coverage/symbols before raw price reads, cached reuse and final consumption. Single/search/portfolio/controls/paired/passive accounts preserve exact costs. Passive long-only comparisons retain the assumptions but have no short borrowing mechanics.
verification: Author49-share flat paths, exact piecewise minute/weekend charges, recall-clear latch and gap priority, unaffected longs, same-close/limit availability boundaries, split/distribution interactions, future-append invariance, shared capital and all API/worker/final/recovery guards. Real desktop input/error/run/trade/report/offline exports must agree with saved records. The separate stdlib Decimal oracle must not import production borrowing helpers. Retain first failures. Sensitivity executes separate0/3/10/30 percent accounts; never rescale old P&L. All original411 cases remain mandatory.
